# Committee Editing

## Problem

Once committees are created, there's a need to modify their structure, add or remove members, and update positions.

## Recommended Solution

Add comprehensive committee editing capabilities for admins:

- Edit committee information (name, description, purpose)
- Add new members to committees
- Remove members from committees
- Update member positions/roles
- Change committee leadership
- Set committee status (Active, Inactive, Archived)
- View committee history and changes
- Bulk operations for adding/removing multiple members

## Context

This feature builds on the Committee/Club Management feature and provides full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations. Admins should have a dedicated interface to manage committee structure and membership efficiently. This is essential for maintaining accurate organizational records throughout the school year.
